endgames.name: Queen and king against king
endgames.tip: Use the queen to box the king in, a knight's move away, then bring your king. Watch out for stalemate.

endgames.name: Rook and king against king
endgames.tip: Cut the king off with the rook, bring your king up to take the opposition, then check.

endgames.name: King and pawn: king in front
endgames.tip: Your king on the sixth rank in front of the pawn always wins. Control the promotion square.

endgames.name: Holding king against king and pawn
endgames.tip: Stay in front of the pawn and take the opposition whenever the white king steps forward.

endgames.name: Two bishops mate
endgames.tip: The bishops work side by side as a wall. Drive the king to a corner with help from your king.

endgames.name: Lucena: building a bridge
endgames.tip: Check the king further away, put your rook on the fourth rank, then walk your king out and block the checks.

endgames.name: Philidor: holding the draw
endgames.tip: Keep your rook on the third rank. When the pawn reaches the sixth, check from behind.

endgames.name: Bishop and knight mate
endgames.tip: Mate only happens in a corner of your bishop's colour. Drive the king there with the W manoeuvre of the knight.
